# API index — Gökhan Turhan

> Checked 2026-11-14. Seven product APIs are published on this host, above the former-domain archive. A call under /ishtar, /curb, /launch, /plaintext, /accumulator, /numetal or /status is proxied to the live worker. These pages do not take a payment. A 402 on a paid path is the worker's challenge, and its resource URL still names the worker host. Contact: contact@gokhan.vc.

The products are at https://gokhanturhan.com/products/. Live calls omit the /api prefix. The /api/ pages are this index.

## Tags

Purpose: reading, publishing, payments, identity, agents, status, files.
Protocol: x402, mpp, mcp, openapi, rss, skill, hmac.

## Machine-readable

- [apis.json](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/apis.json): register, with domain, tags, protocols, and the check
- [openapi.json](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of this index
- [agent.json](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/.well-known/agent.json): agent card
- [sitemap.xml](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/sitemap.xml): every page on this host

## Views

- [x402 manifests](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/x402/): frozen payment manifests. Do not pay.
- [MCP servers](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/mcp/): former MCP servers, listed for the record.
- [Retired endpoints](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/retired/): what retired endpoints return, and where each product now lives

## gokhanturhan.com

Published call prefixes. Docs for each one stay at /api/<slug>/.

- [Ishtar API](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/ishtar/): call https://api.gokhanturhan.com/ishtar/. GET /ishtar/health returned 200 with mode idle. Status degraded. An unpaid POST /ishtar/api/chat/ask is the worker 402. The signed resource is still https://api.ishtar.numetal.xyz/api/chat/ask. Docs: https://api.gokhanturhan.com/ishtar/. Product: https://gokhanturhan.com/ishtar/.
- [CURB clearing API](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/curb/): call https://api.gokhanturhan.com/curb/. GET /curb/health returned 200. Status live. An unpaid POST /curb/v1/pay is the worker 402. The signed resource is still https://curb.numetal.xyz/v1/pay. Docs: https://api.gokhanturhan.com/curb/. Product: https://gokhanturhan.com/curb/.
- [Launch router](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/launch/): call https://api.gokhanturhan.com/launch/. GET /launch/.well-known/mpp.json returned 200. Status live. The origin field is still https://launch.numetal.xyz. Docs: https://api.gokhanturhan.com/launch/. Product: https://gokhanturhan.com/launch/.
- [Plaintext board](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/plaintext/): call https://api.gokhanturhan.com/plaintext/. GET /plaintext/health and GET /plaintext/api/v1/board returned 200. Status live. POST /api/v1/remark was not sent. Docs: https://api.gokhanturhan.com/plaintext/. Product: https://gokhanturhan.com/plaintext/.
- [Accumulator waitlist + wishlist](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/accumulator/): call https://api.gokhanturhan.com/accumulator/. GET https://accumulator.numetal.xyz/api/wishlist returned 200. GET /accumulator/api/wishlist on this host returned a Cloudflare challenge on 2026-11-14. Status live. Docs: https://api.gokhanturhan.com/accumulator/. Product: https://gokhanturhan.com/accumulator/.
- [Numetal fees and burns](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/numetal-fees/): call https://api.gokhanturhan.com/numetal/. GET https://gokhanturhan.com/numetal/fees/data returned 200 JSON. Status live. Docs: https://api.gokhanturhan.com/numetal-fees/. Product: https://gokhanturhan.com/numetal/.
- [Numetal status](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/status/): call https://api.gokhanturhan.com/status/. GET /status/health returned 200. GET /status/status.json returned 200 and reported overall outage. Status degraded. Docs: https://api.gokhanturhan.com/status/. Product: https://gokhanturhan.com/numetal/status/.

## numetal.xyz

- [Ishtar API](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/ishtar/): purpose reading, publishing, payments, identity, agents. protocol x402, mcp, openapi, skill. status degraded. Former base: api.ishtar.numetal.xyz. Check: GET https://api.ishtar.numetal.xyz/health returned 200 with mode idle. GET /api/public/stats returned 200. Paid and write paths were not called. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/ishtar/.
- [CURB clearing API](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/curb/): purpose payments, reading, agents. protocol x402, mcp, openapi, skill. status live. Former base: curb.numetal.xyz (+ api.curb.numetal.xyz). Check: GET https://curb.numetal.xyz/health and https://api.curb.numetal.xyz/health returned 200. Pay was not called. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/curb/.
- [CURB harness, buyer and seller agents](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/curb-agents/): purpose agents, payments. protocol none. status live. Former base: harness.curb · buyer.curb · seller.curb .numetal.xyz. Check: GET https://buyer.curb.numetal.xyz/health and https://seller.curb.numetal.xyz/health returned 200. https://harness.curb.numetal.xyz/ followed a redirect to the estate homepage. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/curb/harness/.
- [Launch router](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/launch/): purpose publishing, payments, agents. protocol x402, mpp, mcp, openapi. status live. Former base: launch.numetal.xyz. Check: GET https://launch.numetal.xyz/api/health returned 200. GET /.well-known/mpp.json and GET /.well-known/x402 returned 200. No launch was signed. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/launch/.
- [Numetal fees and burns](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/numetal-fees/): purpose reading, status. protocol none. status live. Former base: numetal.xyz/fees. Check: GET https://gokhanturhan.com/numetal/fees/data and GET /numetal/fees/events returned 200. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/numetal/.
- [Numetal status](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/status/): purpose status, reading. protocol none. status degraded. Former base: status.numetal.xyz. Check: GET https://status.numetal.xyz/health returned 200. GET /status.json returned 200 and reported overall outage. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/numetal/status/.
- [Plaintext board](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/plaintext/): purpose reading, publishing, payments, agents. protocol mcp, skill, rss. status live. Former base: plaintext.numetal.xyz. Check: GET https://plaintext.numetal.xyz/health and GET /api/v1/board returned 200. POST /api/v1/remark was not sent. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/plaintext/.
- [Accumulator waitlist + wishlist](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/accumulator/): purpose identity, reading. protocol none. status live. Former base: accumulator.numetal.xyz. Check: GET https://accumulator.numetal.xyz/api/wishlist and the estate copy returned 200. POST /api/waitlist and POST /api/wishlist/vote were not sent. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/accumulator/.
- [Personal Jesus waitlist](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/jesus/): purpose identity. protocol none. status degraded. Former base: jesus.numetal.xyz. Check: GET https://jesus.numetal.xyz/ returned 200 HTML. POST /join was not sent. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/jesus/.
- [LLMCraft waitlist](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/llmcraft/): purpose identity. protocol none. status degraded. Former base: llmcraft.numetal.xyz. Check: GET https://llmcraft.numetal.xyz/ returned 200 HTML. The waitlist form was not posted. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/llmcraft/.
- [APEX Protocol](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/apex/): purpose agents, reading. protocol none. status live. Former base: apex.numetal.xyz. Check: GET https://apex.numetal.xyz/llms.txt returned 200. GET https://gokhanturhan.com/apex/llms.txt returned 404. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/apex/.
- [Asset host](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/assets/): purpose files. protocol none. status retired. Former base: assets.numetal.xyz. Check: GET https://assets.numetal.xyz/ did not resolve. No DNS. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/numetal/.

## gokhan.vc

- [Estate gateway (feedhub)](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/feedhub/): purpose reading, publishing, payments, agents. protocol x402, openapi, rss. status retired. Former base: api.gokhan.vc. Check: GET https://api.gokhan.vc/ did not resolve. No DNS. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/gokhan-vc/api/.
- [Newsletter (email + XMTP)](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/newsletter/): purpose publishing, identity. protocol hmac. status retired. Former base: api.gokhan.vc/newsletter. Check: The newsletter lived on api.gokhan.vc, which has no DNS. Subscribe was not called. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/gokhan-vc/api/.
- [XMTP bot](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/xmtp/): purpose agents. protocol none. status retired. Former base: xmtp-bot.gokhan.vc. Check: GET https://xmtp-bot.gokhan.vc/ did not resolve. No DNS. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/gokhan-vc/api/.
- [x402 live panel](https://api.gokhanturhan.com/x402-live/): purpose payments, reading. protocol x402. status retired. Former base: gokhan.vc/x402-live/. Check: HEAD https://gokhan.vc/x402-live/ returned 404. Product page: https://gokhanturhan.com/gokhan-vc/.
